lesson.uz: Massiv bir nechta qiymatni bitta nom ostida saqlaydi. Elementlarga indeks bilan murojaat qilinadi (0 dan).
lesson.en: An array stores several values under one name. Elements are accessed by index (from 0).

Birinchi qatorda mahsulotlar soni N, keyin N ta narx kiritiladi. Eng arzon narxni va u nechanchi ekanini (1 dan, birinchi uchragani) alohida qatorlarda chiqaring.
statement.en: N products are entered first, then N prices. Print the lowest price and its position (from 1, first occurrence) on separate lines.

statement.uz: Birinchi qatorda o'quvchilar soni N, keyin N ta ball kiritiladi. O'rtacha balldan (kasr bilan) qat'iy yuqori ball olganlar nechta?
statement.en: N students are entered first, then N scores. How many scored strictly above the average (as a decimal)?

statement.uz: Birinchi qatorda N, keyin N ta son kiritiladi. Ularni teskari tartibda, har birini alohida qatorda chiqaring.
statement.en: N is entered first, then N numbers. Print them in reverse order, one per line.

statement.uz: Birinchi qatorda N, keyin N ta son kiritiladi. Birinchi kiritilgan son jami necha marta uchrashini (o'zi ham hisobga) chiqaring.
statement.en: N is entered first, then N numbers. Print how many times the first number appears in total (including itself).

statement.uz: Birinchi qatorda N, keyin N ta son kiritiladi. Indeksi juft (0, 2, 4, ...) bo'lgan elementlar yig'indisini chiqaring.
statement.en: N is entered first, then N numbers. Print the sum of the elements whose index is even (0, 2, 4, ...).

statement.uz: Birinchi qatorda N, keyin N ta son kiritiladi. Ro'yxatni bir qadam chapga siljiting: birinchi element oxiriga o'tadi. Natijani har bir son alohida qatorda chiqaring.
statement.en: N is entered first, then N numbers. Rotate the list one step left: the first element moves to the end. Print the result, one number per line.

statement.uz: Birinchi qatorda N (N ≥ 2), keyin N ta son kiritiladi; kamida ikkita har xil son bor. Eng kattasidan keyingi, takrorlanmaydigan ikkinchi eng katta qiymatni chiqaring.
statement.en: N (N ≥ 2) is entered first, then N numbers with at least two different values. Print the second largest distinct value.
